in_hebrew.name: Burk
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Burk הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old High German ‘berah’, meaning ‘bright’, ‘famous’ or ‘ruler’. The name Burk has been associated with brave warriors and rulers in Germanic history. The name gained popularity among Christians due to its strong and noble connotations.
